## 🔍 Overview

WISE AI is a web-based deepfake detection system that leverages the **Google Gemini Generative Language API** for AI-powered media analysis. It inspects uploaded media files and provides a likelihood assessment of whether the content is real, deepfake, or AI-generated — all running directly in the browser with no server required.

---

## ✨ Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| 🖼️ **Image Detection** | Analyzes image content for AI manipulation patterns |
| 🎥 **Video Detection** | Frame-by-frame deepfake analysis for video content |
| 🎵 **Audio Detection** | Detects synthetic and AI-generated speech elements |
| 🎨 **Modern Interface** | User-friendly UI with drag & drop support |
| ⚡ **Instant Result Preview** | Quick in-browser result rendering after analysis |
| 🎯 **Detailed Output** | Enhanced scoring algorithm with multiple detection indicators |

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)
- **API**: [Google Gemini Generative Language API](https://ai.google.dev/)
- **UI Framework**: Custom CSS with Font Awesome Icons
- **File Handling**: HTML5 File API
- **Model**: Gemini text-generation prompts for content analysis

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- A modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari)
- A valid **Google Gemini API key** — get one at [aistudio.google.com](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey)
- No backend or server installation required

### Installation

**1. Clone the repository**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/ibrahimrasyid/WISE-AI.git
cd WISE-AI
```

**2. Get your Gemini API Key**

- Go to [aistudio.google.com/app/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey)
- Click **"Create API Key"**
- Copy the generated key

**3. Configure your API Key**

Open `js/deepware.js` and find this line:

```javascript
const GEMINI_API_KEY = 'your_gemini_api_key_here';
```

Replace `your_gemini_api_key_here` with your actual Gemini API key:

```javascript
const GEMINI_API_KEY = 'AIzaSy_your_actual_key_here';
```

**4. Run the application**

Open `deepware-api.html` directly in your browser:

```bash
# On Windows
start deepware-api.html

# On macOS
open deepware-api.html

# Or use a local server (recommended)
npx serve .
```

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

The Gemini API key is set directly in `js/deepware.js` for demo/educational purposes.

## 📖 Usage

1. Open `deepware-api.html` in your browser
2. Upload a file using drag & drop or the file picker button
3. Click **"Analyze Content"**
4. Wait for Gemini API to process your file
5. Review the detailed detection results

---

## 📂 Supported Formats

| Media Type | Supported Formats |
|---|---|
| 🖼️ **Image** | JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP |
| 🎥 **Video** | MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM |
| 🎵 **Audio** | MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC |

> Maximum file size: **100MB**

---

## 📊 Analysis Results

After analysis, the system provides:

- **Authenticity Score** — Estimated content authenticity (0–100%)
- **Manipulation Risk** — Risk level: `Low` / `Medium` / `High`
- **Confidence Level** — Overall confidence of the analysis: `Low` / `Medium` / `High` / `Very High`
- **Detailed Analysis** — Gemini-generated summary of detected patterns and artifacts
- **Recommendations** — Suggested next actions based on the detection outcome

---

## 🔧 Troubleshooting

### ❌ Error: "API request failed"
- Check your internet connection
- Make sure your Gemini API key is valid and active
- Verify the key is correctly set in `js/deepware.js`
- Confirm the Gemini API endpoint is accessible from your network

### ❌ File not detected / not processing
- Make sure the file format is supported (see [Supported Formats](#-supported-formats))
- Check that the file size is under 100MB
- Refresh the page and retry the upload

### ❌ API key-related errors
- Validate the key at [aistudio.google.com](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey)
- Confirm the key has access to the **Generative Language API**
- Check that the API is enabled in your Google Cloud project

---

## 🔒 Security

- ✅ No server-side storage — files are processed entirely in the browser
- ✅ No user data is stored or logged by this application
- ⚠️ For production deployments, move API calls to a secure backend to avoid exposing credentials
